primary.title: Dearness Allowance: Increase in basic salary component, 3-4% hike expected — Why is DA important?
primary.summary: Dearness Allowance (DA) is a percentage of salary for central government employees and pensioners to offset inflation. Updated bi-annually, it rose from 58% to 60% in January 2026, benefiting 50 lakh employees and 65 lakh pensioners. Future hikes depend on AICPI data and government approval.
